name: Paint-Ready Valley Fluted Panels
summary: Low-VOC MDF with a Valley profile of concave scoops routed into the face, five coats of white primer sanded flat, and a PVC film on the back.

texture.note: Manufacturer specs override photo estimates: nine 1.31 in repeats, each a 1.18 in concave scoop and 0.13 in flat peak, with a 0.31 in cut and 0.37 in total thickness; nine stated pitches span 11.79 in versus the listed 11.80 in panel width. The main photo supplies the white sanded-primer finish over MDF, with no visible wood grain or backing; the circular scoop shape follows the close-ups, and the tile covers 11.79 by 23.58 in.
